sources.author: Harrison Chase
sources.headline: Co-founder & CEO @ LangChain
sources.post_summary: Discussed the rapid evolution of AI agents, highlighting how multi-step reasoning and tool use are becoming production-ready. Shared benchmarks showing 3x improvement in agent reliability over the past quarter and stressed the importance of evaluation frameworks.

sources.author: Swyx
sources.headline: Founder @ Latent Space, Writer & Investor
sources.post_summary: Analyzed the current AI infrastructure landscape, focusing on inference cost optimization and open-source model serving. Covered recent developments in vLLM and TensorRT-LLM and their impact on developer tooling for production deployments.

sources.author: Simon Willison
sources.headline: Independent AI Researcher & Creator of Datasette
sources.post_summary: Shared practical insights on building reliable AI automation workflows using LLMs as coding assistants. Demonstrated a new CLI tool that auto-generates tests and documentation, cutting development time by 40%.

sources.author: Clem Delangue
sources.headline: Co-founder & CEO @ Hugging Face
sources.post_summary: Posted about the latest Hugging Face inference endpoints updates, emphasizing new autoscaling features and cost-efficient GPU allocation for AI agents. Highlighted real-world use cases from enterprise customers running thousands of agent workflows daily.

sources.author: Elena Vasquez
sources.headline: Head of Revenue Operations @ Notion
sources.post_summary: Discussed how her team built a unified RevOps dashboard that integrates CRM, marketing automation, and customer success data. Highlighted a 40% reduction in lead handoff time and improved forecasting accuracy by aligning sales and marketing KPIs.

sources.author: Marcus Chen
sources.headline: GTM Engineer @ Ramp | Ex-Salesforce
sources.post_summary: Shared a case study on implementing outbound automation sequences using Clay + custom enrichment workflows. Explained how his team increased qualified meetings by 3x while reducing manual SDR tasks by 60%.

sources.author: Priya Sharma
sources.headline: VP Content Strategy @ HubSpot
sources.post_summary: Outlined a content-led GTM motion where product education content is embedded into the sales process. Showed how aligning content with buyer journey stages increased demo-to-close rates by 28%.

sources.author: David Okoro
sources.headline: Founder @ RevScale | Sales Ops Consultant
sources.post_summary: Broke down common pitfalls in scaling outbound automation, including data decay and poor signal prioritization. Shared a framework for maintaining high deliverability and intent-based targeting in automated sequences.

sources.author: Sofia Patel
sources.headline: Director of Revenue Operations @ Deel
sources.post_summary: Explained how her team operationalized GTM experiments using a lightweight testing framework across marketing, sales, and CS. Emphasized the importance of cross-functional ownership and rapid iteration cycles.

sources.author: Pieter Levels
sources.headline: Founder @ Nomad List, Remote OK | Solo founder shipping products
sources.post_summary: Shared an update on launching a new AI-powered travel tool built solo in under 3 weeks. Discussed the tech stack, user feedback loop, and how he validates ideas quickly by shipping MVPs publicly.

sources.author: Danny Postma
sources.headline: Founder & Maker | Building AI products in public
sources.post_summary: Posted about pivoting from a failed SaaS to a new AI image tool. Detailed the decision process, lessons from the previous launch, and how transparent sharing helped attract early users.

sources.author: Arvid Kahl
sources.headline: Bootstrapped founder, author of Zero to Sold
sources.post_summary: Wrote about transitioning from corporate engineering to full-time indie hacking. Highlighted the mindset shifts required and shared metrics from his first year of solo product building.

sources.author: Marc Lou
sources.headline: Indie Maker | Shipping micro-SaaS in public
sources.post_summary: Documented the launch of a new productivity micro-SaaS built in 10 days. Included revenue numbers from the first week, technical challenges overcome, and advice for other solo builders.

sources.author: Sara Mauskopf
sources.headline: Founder & CEO @ Winnie | Ex-Google, career pivot advocate
sources.post_summary: Shared her journey from product management at big tech to founding a startup. Focused on the skills that transferred and the unexpected challenges of going from employee to founder.
